name: nl.alle-providers/internet
title: Alle Providers
description: Home internet offers at a Dutch address: providers, prices, line speeds and order links.

tools.name: zoek_aanbod
tools.description: Find home internet offers (fiber, cable, DSL, 5G) at a Dutch address, with average monthly price, line speed, contract length and an order link. Zoekt het internetaanbod op een Nederlands adres. Een adres dat we deze week nog niet hebben gecheckt, kan tot ongeveer een minuut duren.

postcode.description: Dutch postcode, four digits and two letters, e.g. "1234AB" or "1234 AB".

huisnummer.description: House number, e.g. 12. A suffix like "12A" or "12-2" is split into toevoeging.

toevoeging.description: House number addition such as "A", "2" or "bis". Omit when there is none.

looptijd.description: Contract length in months: 1 (monthly cancellable), 12 or 24. Default 12.

pakket.description: Package: internet (default), internet-tv, internet-bellen (phone) or alles-in-een.

techniek.description: Only this connection: glasvezel (fiber), coax (cable), koper (DSL) or draadloos.

max_prijs.description: Maximum average price in euro per month.

sorteer.description: Sort by prijs-per-mbit (value, default, as on the site), prijs (price) or snelheid (speed).

aantal.description: Number of offers (a provider can have one per connection type). Default 10.

tools.name: aansluitingen
tools.description: Which fixed connections reach a Dutch address: fiber, coax (cable) and copper (DSL), with the network owner, line speed and any network fee. Every listed connection is at the address. state "present" means the line is in the meter closet and can be ordered on; say so plainly, as the site does, and do not call it unconfirmed or unknown. Fiber can also be "connected", "planned", "in_street", "awaiting_connection" or "new_build". Use stateDescription and summary as given. Welke kabels er op een adres liggen, en of glasvezel aangesloten of gepland is.

postcode.description: Dutch postcode, four digits and two letters, e.g. "1234AB" or "1234 AB".

huisnummer.description: House number, e.g. 12. A suffix like "12A" or "12-2" is split into toevoeging.

toevoeging.description: House number addition such as "A", "2" or "bis". Omit when there is none.

tools.name: zoek_gids
tools.description: Search the alle-providers.nl guides, provider pages and comparisons (Dutch): switching provider, fiber installation, modems, network fees, a specific provider. Zoekt in de gidsen en providerpagina’s. Geeft titels, links en de passende alinea’s.

vraag.description: Search terms or question, Dutch works best.
